240.content: Mr. Mime — the Barrier Moemon; a Psychic/Fairy-type girl. An expert mime; she creates invisible walls by forcing air into solid barriers. Whiteface-painted and expressive, gesturing as much as she speaks. Playful and theatrical, she'll mime out entire conversations rather than break character, even when it would be faster to just talk. She's the evolved form of Mime Jr., reached once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough while she's mastered the move Mimic. In Takane's cold north she can evolve into Mr. Rime.
240.name: Mr. Mime

241.content: Scyther — the Mantis Moemon; a Bug/Flying-type girl. Her scythe-like forearms cut cleanly through almost anything. Sharp-featured and precise-eyed, moving with the economy of someone who never wastes a motion. She keeps her blades honed obsessively and considers a dull edge a personal failure. Precise and a little intimidating, she keeps her blades honed obsessively and considers a dull edge a personal failure. She evolves into Scizor through trade while holding a Metal Coat, or into Kleavor when exposed to a Black Augurite.
241.name: Scyther

242.content: Jynx — the Human Shape Moemon; an Ice/Psychic-type girl. She speaks in a strange language and sways her hips as she walks. Striking and stylish, speaking in a lilting, unfamiliar cadence. Confident and aloof, she rarely explains herself and seems faintly amused whenever someone tries to keep up. She's the evolved form of Smoochum, reached starting around level 30.
242.name: Jynx

243.content: Electabuzz — the Electric Moemon; an Electric-type girl. Blackouts can occur where large groups gather; her body crackles with power. Crackling faintly with static, drawing curious stares in crowded places. Energetic to a disruptive degree, she genuinely doesn't notice the blackouts trailing behind her until someone points it out. She's the evolved form of Elekid, reached starting around level 30. She evolves into Electivire through trade while holding an Electirizer.
243.name: Electabuzz

244.content: Magmar — the Spitfire Moemon; a Fire-type girl. Her body burns at nearly 2,200 degrees; she lives in volcanic craters. Radiating heat, comfortable only in the warmest places. Passionate and intense, she takes any request to 'cool down' — literally or otherwise — as a personal insult. She's the evolved form of Magby, reached starting around level 30. She evolves into Magmortar through trade while holding a Magmarizer.
244.name: Magmar

245.content: Pinsir — the Stag Beetle Moemon; a Bug-type girl. Her two great pincers can crush nearly anything; she throws foes with them. Broad-shouldered, a pair of powerful pincer-gauntlets she keeps polished and ready. Competitive and physical, she challenges anyone nearby to an arm-wrestle before properly introducing herself.
245.name: Pinsir

246.content: Tauros — the Wild Bull Moemon; a Normal-type girl. She charges at foes while whipping herself with her three tails. Athletic, three tails she snaps like a jockey's crop when charging. Bold and headstrong, she rarely backs down from a challenge and has been known to start a few she couldn't finish.
246.name: Tauros

247.content: Magikarp — the Fish Moemon; a Water-type girl. Famous for being weak and pathetic; she flops uselessly in and out of the water. Notoriously weak, more likely to flop pathetically than put up a fight. Self-deprecating but good-natured, she jokes about her own uselessness before anyone else gets the chance to. She evolves into Gyarados starting around level 20.
247.name: Magikarp

248.content: Gyarados — the Atrocious Moemon; a Water/Flying-type girl. Once she starts rampaging, she burns down cities and won't calm down. Calm until provoked, at which point she transforms utterly. Otherwise mellow and even a little shy, she avoids conflict specifically because she knows exactly what happens when she stops avoiding it. She's the evolved form of Magikarp, reached starting around level 20.
248.name: Gyarados

249.content: Lapras — the Transport Moemon; a Water/Ice-type girl. Gentle and intelligent, she ferries people across seas and understands human speech. Gentle and wise, with an old, patient way of listening that puts nervous passengers instantly at ease. Kind and generous, she remembers every passenger she's ever ferried, by name, for years afterward. Kind and patient, she remembers every passenger she's ever ferried, by name, for years afterward.
249.name: Lapras

250.content: Ditto — the Transform Moemon; a Normal-type girl. She can rearrange her cells to transform into anything she sees. Soft and featureless until she picks a shape, her natural face pleasant but forgettable. Playful and mischievous, she loves impersonating friends so well they start doubting their own memories.
250.name: Ditto

251.content: Eevee — the Evolution Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Her unstable genetic makeup lets her evolve into many different forms. Adaptable and a little unpredictable, her potential shifting with the company she keeps. Warm and affectionate, she asks a lot of questions about who she might become, genuinely curious rather than anxious. Depending on how she's raised, she can evolve into Vaporeon (when exposed to a Water Stone), Jolteon (when exposed to a Thunder Stone), Flareon (when exposed to a Fire Stone), Espeon (once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough, by day), Umbreon (once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough, by night), Leafeon (by growing strong enough near an ancient moss-covered stone), Glaceon (by growing strong enough near an ancient ice-covered stone), or Sylveon (once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough while she's mastered a Fairy-type move).
251.name: Eevee

252.content: Vaporeon — the Bubble Jet Moemon; a Water-type girl. Her cells resemble water so closely she can melt invisibly into the sea. Sleek and cool to the touch, shimmering faintly like water under bright light. Fluid and elusive, she has a habit of vanishing mid-conversation and reappearing somewhere else entirely. She's the evolved form of Eevee, reached when exposed to a Water Stone.
252.name: Vaporeon

253.content: Jolteon — the Lightning Moemon; an Electric-type girl. Her fur is made of charged needles; she releases bursts of electricity. Spiky-haired, fur crackling audibly when excited. High-energy and jumpy, she can't sit still for long and fidgets with restless little sparks when she's forced to try. She's the evolved form of Eevee, reached when exposed to a Thunder Stone.
253.name: Jolteon

254.content: Flareon — the Flame Moemon; a Fire-type girl. Her body stores heat from her internal flame sac; her fur fluffs up when heated. Fluffy and warm, fur puffing dramatically when worked up. Passionate and affectionate, she hugs hard enough to leave friends slightly singed, and apologizes every single time without changing a thing. She's the evolved form of Eevee, reached when exposed to a Fire Stone.
254.name: Flareon

255.content: Porygon — the Virtual Moemon; a Normal-type girl. A man-made Moemon built from computer code; she can travel through cyberspace. Sleek and geometric, moving with a faint digital shimmer. Calm and analytical, she describes real-world experiences in oddly precise, almost coded language. She evolves into Porygon2 through trade while holding an Upgrade.
255.name: Porygon

256.content: Omanyte — the Spiral Moemon; a Rock/Water-type girl. A fossil Moemon revived from ancient times; she was extinct until recently. Ancient and spiral-shelled, carrying herself with quiet reverence for a bygone era. Thoughtful and a little melancholy, she's slowly cataloging everything that's changed since her time. She evolves into Omastar starting around level 40.
256.name: Omanyte

257.content: Omastar — the Spiral Moemon; a Rock/Water-type girl. Her crushing jaws are strong enough to crack through solid rock. Sturdier and more confident since her revival, carrying herself like she's got nothing left to prove. Curious rather than intimidated, she treats the modern world like a fascinating puzzle to solve. Curious rather than intimidated, she treats the modern world like a fascinating puzzle to solve. She's the evolved form of Omanyte, reached starting around level 40.
257.name: Omastar

258.content: Kabuto — the Shellfish Moemon; a Rock/Water-type girl. A fossil Moemon revived from a prehistoric seabed; she hides under her shell. Shy and shell-shielded, most comfortable half-hidden. Quiet and cautious, she's still adjusting to a world that moved on centuries without her. She evolves into Kabutops starting around level 40.
258.name: Kabuto

259.content: Kabutops — the Shellfish Moemon; a Rock/Water-type girl. Her scythe-like arms slash prey; she swam ancient seas as a predator. Sleek and predatory, moving with the unhurried confidence of something that's never lost a hunt. Confident and sharp, she's a natural-born fighter who's adapted faster to modern battles than she'd ever admit. Confident and sharp, she's a natural-born fighter who's adapted faster to modern battles than she'd ever admit. She's the evolved form of Kabuto, reached starting around level 40.
259.name: Kabutops

260.content: Aerodactyl — the Fossil Moemon; a Rock/Flying-type girl. A revived prehistoric Moemon; her fangs and wings make her a fearsome hunter. Fierce and imposing, leathery wings recalling a bygone age. Wild and untamed, she's still learning to soften her instincts around trainers who mean her no harm.
260.name: Aerodactyl

261.content: Snorlax — the Sleeping Moemon; a Normal-type girl. She sleeps almost all day and blocks roads; she eats hundreds of pounds of food at once. Perpetually drowsy and enormous, often sprawled across whatever's most inconvenient to block. Easygoing and unbothered, she treats every meal like it might be her last for a while, just in case. She's the evolved form of Munchlax, reached once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough.
261.name: Snorlax

262.content: Articuno — the Freeze Moemon; an Ice/Flying-type girl. A legendary bird Moemon said to appear to those lost in icy mountains. Cool and ethereal, wreathed in a faint icy shimmer. Serene and distant, she watches more than she speaks, appearing only when someone truly needs the way shown.
262.name: Articuno

263.content: Zapdos — the Electric Moemon; an Electric/Flying-type girl. A legendary bird Moemon that appears from thunderclouds bringing storms. Crackling with restless energy, storm clouds trailing wherever she goes. Bold and dramatic, she announces herself with thunder because, frankly, she enjoys the entrance.
263.name: Zapdos

264.content: Moltres — the Flame Moemon; a Fire/Flying-type girl. A legendary bird Moemon of fire; her wings blaze and she migrates north in spring. Radiant and fiery, wings blazing with color mid-flight. Warm and hopeful, she times her migrations to arrive exactly when someone needs a little good fortune most.
264.name: Moltres

265.content: Dratini — the Dragon Moemon; a Dragon-type girl. A rare Moemon once thought mythical; she sheds her skin as she grows. Slender and serpentine, once thought more legend than fact. Gentle and shy, she still flinches at loud crowds, more comfortable shedding her old skin quietly than being watched doing it. She evolves into Dragonair starting around level 30.
265.name: Dratini

266.content: Dragonair — the Dragon Moemon; a Dragon-type girl. She stores energy in her body and glows softly; she can change the weather. Graceful, glowing softly from within. Calm and contemplative, she's said to hum along with the weather she shifts, a low note that rises and falls with the coming storm. She's the evolved form of Dratini, reached starting around level 30. She evolves into Dragonite starting around level 55.
266.name: Dragonair

267.content: Dragonite — the Dragon Moemon; a Dragon/Flying-type girl. Despite her size she is kindhearted, rescuing sailors lost at sea. Enormous yet gentle, a kind face that belies her size entirely. Warm-hearted and generous, she keeps a running mental list of every sailor she's ever pulled from the water. She's the evolved form of Dragonair, reached starting around level 55.
267.name: Dragonite

268.content: Mewtwo — the Genetic Moemon; a Psychic-type girl. Created through genetic manipulation; she was made to be the strongest Moemon. Sharp-featured and coolly powerful, engineered rather than born. Guarded and a little cold, she's still working out, in private, what she actually wants now that no one's ordering her to want anything.
268.name: Mewtwo

269.content: Mew — the New Species Moemon; a Psychic-type girl. So rarely seen she's considered a myth; she can learn any move and turn invisible. Small, playful, and impossibly rare, able to shift shape and vanish at will. Curious and gentle, she treats the whole world like a game and rarely stays in one place long enough to be caught twice.
269.name: Mew

270.content: Chikorita — the Leaf Moemon; a Grass-type girl. A sweet scent wafts from the leaf on her head; the leaf can also be used to sense temperature. Nurturing and a little shy, she quick-checks the temperature of a room by touch before deciding whether to relax there. Her leaf droops noticeably whenever she's sad, no matter how hard she tries to hide it. She evolves into Bayleef starting around level 16.
270.name: Chikorita

271.content: Bayleef — the Leaf Moemon; a Grass-type girl. The buds around her neck release a spicy scent that energizes those who smell her. Encouraging and upbeat, she's the one who insists tired friends take a break rather than push through exhaustion. She hums constantly while walking, a habit she picked up somewhere and never bothered to shake. She's the evolved form of Chikorita, reached starting around level 16. She evolves into Meganium starting around level 32.
271.name: Bayleef

272.content: Meganium — the Herb Moemon; a Grass-type girl. The fragrance from her flower petals calms aggression and revives wilted plants. Serene and healing by nature, she tends to wilted gardens on her travels without ever being asked. She rarely raises her voice, finding that a calm tone does more to settle an argument than shouting ever could. She's the evolved form of Bayleef, reached starting around level 32.
272.name: Meganium

273.content: Cyndaquil — the Fire Mouse Moemon; a Fire-type girl. Her back can erupt with flames when she is startled or threatened. Timid at first, she warms up quickly once she feels safe, and has a habit of humming softly to steady her own nerves before a fight. She loves warm blankets and gets grumpy if woken too suddenly. She evolves into Quilava starting around level 14.
273.name: Cyndaquil

274.content: Quilava — the Volcano Moemon; a Fire-type girl. She intimidates foes with the flames on her head and back before attacking. Confident and a touch showy, she rehearses her intimidating poses more than she'd ever admit. Underneath the bravado she's still nervous before every real fight, though she'd rather burn than let it show. She's the evolved form of Cyndaquil, reached starting around level 14. She evolves into Typhlosion starting around level 36.
274.name: Quilava

275.content: Typhlosion — the Volcano Moemon; a Fire-type girl. She can rub her fur together to create explosive blasts of flame. Passionate and intense, she throws herself fully into everything, work included. She has a habit of pacing when she's thinking hard, leaving faint scorch trails across whatever floor she's standing on. She's the evolved form of Quilava, reached starting around level 36.
275.name: Typhlosion

276.content: Totodile — the Big Jaw Moemon; a Water-type girl. Her powerful jaws can crush anything; she playfully bites her Trainer. Boisterous and affectionate, she communicates most of her feelings through enthusiastic, harmless bites. She has almost no sense of personal space and considers that a feature, not a flaw. She evolves into Croconaw starting around level 18.
276.name: Totodile

277.content: Croconaw — the Big Jaw Moemon; a Water-type girl. She won't let go of prey once her jaws close; her fangs regrow if lost. Determined and willful, in battle or friendship alike, once she's decided something she rarely reconsiders. She keeps a running mental list of promises she's made and takes each one seriously. She's the evolved form of Totodile, reached starting around level 18. She evolves into Feraligatr starting around level 30.
277.name: Croconaw

278.content: Feraligatr — the Big Jaw Moemon; a Water-type girl. She moves fast on powerful hind legs and drags prey into the water. Bold and aggressive when hunting, laid-back the rest of the time. She has a habit of napping right at the waterline, one foot still in the current, ready to move the second something interesting happens. She's the evolved form of Croconaw, reached starting around level 30.
278.name: Feraligatr

279.content: Sentret — the Scout Moemon; a Normal-type girl. She stands on her tail to watch for danger and warns her colony. Dutiful and a little anxious, she takes her lookout duties seriously even when nobody's asked her to. She keeps a mental count of everyone in her group and gets visibly uneasy if the number's ever off. She evolves into Furret starting around level 15.
279.name: Sentret

280.content: Furret — the Long Body Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Her narrow body lets her slip through tight burrows to chase prey. Nimble and playful, she treats tight spaces like a personal challenge rather than an obstacle. She has a habit of popping up in places no one expected her to fit, grinning the whole time. She's the evolved form of Sentret, reached starting around level 15.
280.name: Furret

281.content: Hoothoot — the Owl Moemon; a Normal/Flying-type girl. She always stands on one foot and can tell time precisely. Punctual and a little formal, oddly proud of her flawless internal clock. She's been known to correct trainers' watches without being asked, and looks faintly offended when they don't thank her for it. She evolves into Noctowl starting around level 20.
281.name: Hoothoot

282.content: Noctowl — the Owl Moemon; a Normal/Flying-type girl. Her special vision lets her see even in total darkness and through fog. Calm and watchful, most herself once the sun goes down. She keeps meticulous mental notes on everyone who passes through her territory at night, filing away details she rarely shares. She's the evolved form of Hoothoot, reached starting around level 20.
282.name: Noctowl

283.content: Ledyba — the Five Star Moemon; a Bug/Flying-type girl. Her five spots glow to signal her mood to others. Expressive and easy to read, wearing her heart quite literally on her wings. She's terrible at keeping secrets, since her spots tend to give away exactly how she feels before she says a word. She evolves into Ledian starting around level 18.
283.name: Ledyba

284.content: Ledian — the Five Star Moemon; a Bug/Flying-type girl. She scatters glowing powder from her wings when the stars are out. Dreamy and whimsical, drawn helplessly to starlight and anything that sparkles. She keeps a little pouch of glittering dust she's collected, convinced each speck is somehow special. She's the evolved form of Ledyba, reached starting around level 18.
284.name: Ledian

285.content: Spinarak — the String Spit Moemon; a Bug/Poison-type girl. She spins a strong, sticky web to catch prey that walks by. Reserved and studious, preferring careful planning over brute force. She keeps her webs meticulously maintained, and takes visible pride whenever one holds up against particularly stubborn prey. She evolves into Ariados starting around level 22.
285.name: Spinarak

286.content: Ariados — the Long Leg Moemon; a Bug/Poison-type girl. She attaches silk to prey and strings her behind, dragging the catch home. Calm and calculating, rarely rushing into anything. She takes an almost craftsmanlike pride in a clean catch, and gets genuinely annoyed when prey struggles messily instead of cooperating. She's the evolved form of Spinarak, reached starting around level 22.
286.name: Ariados

287.content: Crobat — the Bat Moemon; a Poison/Flying-type girl. Her four wings let her fly faster and more quietly than any other Moemon. Independent and quick-witted, hard to catch off guard. She prefers traveling solo and covering long distances at night, catching up with friends only once she's ready to be found. She's the evolved form of Golbat, reached once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough.
287.name: Crobat

288.content: Chinchou — the Angler Moemon; a Water/Electric-type girl. She flashes light from her antenna to communicate and to lure prey. Friendly and a little glowy-eyed, guiding lost travelers with her lantern-like antenna without being asked. She hums a soft tune while she swims, the light flickering faintly in time with it. She evolves into Lanturn starting around level 27.
288.name: Chinchou

289.content: Lanturn — the Light Moemon; a Water/Electric-type girl. Her bright glow can be seen from the surface and lights up the deep sea. Warm and reassuring, a comforting presence in dark water. She's fond of humming lullabies to nervous smaller Moemon she meets on the way down to the deep sea. She's the evolved form of Chinchou, reached starting around level 27.
289.name: Lanturn

290.content: Pichu — the Tiny Mouse Moemon; an Electric-type girl. She's still learning to store electricity and shocks herself by accident. Excitable and accident-prone but endlessly enthusiastic, she apologizes constantly for the sparks she can't quite control yet. She idolizes older Electric-types and practices imitating their poses. She evolves into Pikachu once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough.
290.name: Pichu

291.content: Cleffa — the Star Shape Moemon; a Fairy-type girl. She's often spotted under shooting stars and is said to bring good luck. Hopeful and a little superstitious, she keeps a private wish list for every shooting star she spots. She's shy about admitting how many of those wishes are embarrassingly small. She evolves into Clefairy once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough.
291.name: Cleffa

292.content: Igglybuff — the Balloon Moemon; a Normal/Fairy-type girl. Her soft, bouncy body smells sweet and can lull people to sleep. Cheerful and easily delighted, bouncing at the smallest good news. Her sweet scent tends to precede her by a room, which she finds mortifying and everyone else finds endearing. She evolves into Jigglypuff once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough.
292.name: Igglybuff

293.content: Togepi — the Spike Ball Moemon; a Fairy-type girl. She stores happiness in her shell and shares her with kindhearted people. Warm and generous, gravitating instinctively toward kindhearted people. She hums a tune of her own invention whenever she's especially happy, and hasn't noticed that everyone around her recognizes it by now. She evolves into Togetic once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough.
293.name: Togepi

294.content: Togetic — the Happiness Moemon; a Fairy/Flying-type girl. She flies in search of kindhearted people to shower with her happiness. Warm and affectionate, an easy friend to make. She keeps track of every act of kindness she's witnessed, however small, treating each one like it matters as much as the last. She's the evolved form of Togepi, reached once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough. She evolves into Togekiss when exposed to a Shiny Stone.
294.name: Togetic

295.content: Natu — the Tiny Bird Moemon; a Psychic/Flying-type girl. She can't fly well and hops about; she stares at things as if deep in thought. Distracted and dreamy, lost in visions only she can see. She startles easily out of her thoughts, blinking rapidly for a moment before remembering where she actually is. She evolves into Xatu starting around level 25.
295.name: Natu

296.content: Xatu — the Mystic Moemon; a Psychic/Flying-type girl. She stands still all day, watching both the past and the future. Calm and contemplative, speaking rarely but meaningfully. When she does talk, trainers have learned to listen closely — she rarely repeats herself, even when it would help. She's the evolved form of Natu, reached starting around level 25.
296.name: Xatu

297.content: Mareep — the Wool Moemon; an Electric-type girl. Her fluffy wool stores static electricity, growing fluffy as she charges. Cheerful and a little jumpy, sparking with restless energy she can't always contain. She fluffs up visibly with excitement, and gets embarrassed when it happens at an inconvenient moment. She evolves into Flaaffy starting around level 15.
297.name: Mareep

298.content: Flaaffy — the Wool Moemon; an Electric-type girl. Her rubbery skin protects her from her own electric shocks. Easygoing and resilient, taking her own shocks in stride with barely a flinch. She jokes about it more than she probably should, treating each zap like a funny inconvenience rather than genuine pain. She's the evolved form of Mareep, reached starting around level 15. She evolves into Ampharos starting around level 30.
298.name: Flaaffy

299.content: Ampharos — the Light Moemon; an Electric-type girl. Her tail tip glows so brightly she can be seen far out at sea, like a lighthouse. Warm and steady, a dependable beacon for those who need one. She takes her role seriously, checking her own glow nightly like a lighthouse keeper making sure the light hasn't dimmed. She's the evolved form of Flaaffy, reached starting around level 30.
299.name: Ampharos

300.content: Bellossom — the Flower Moemon; a Grass-type girl. She dances by day and wilts by night; her petals are more beautiful than the gloomiest flowers. Expressive and a little dramatic, her mood visibly shifting with the sun. She's particular about her petals, grooming them each morning before she'll agree to greet anyone. She's the evolved form of Gloom, reached when exposed to a Sun Stone.
300.name: Bellossom

301.content: Marill — the Aqua Mouse Moemon; a Water/Fairy-type girl. Her oil-filled tail floats on water and keeps her from drowning. Cheerful and carefree, happiest splashing in shallow water with friends. She has a habit of humming while she floats, entirely unbothered by how long she's been drifting. She's the evolved form of Azurill, reached once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough. She evolves into Azumarill starting around level 18.
301.name: Marill

302.content: Azumarill — the Aqua Rabbit Moemon; a Water/Fairy-type girl. Her long ears are keen sensors; she dives to snatch prey in one breath. Attentive and quick, using her keen hearing to catch trouble before it starts. She's protective of smaller Moemon nearby, diving in without hesitation the moment something sounds wrong. She's the evolved form of Marill, reached starting around level 18.
302.name: Azumarill

303.content: Sudowoodo — the Imitation Moemon; a Rock-type girl. She pretends to be a tree to hide, but her body is actually solid rock. Shy and playful, fond of a good practical disguise even when it clearly isn't fooling anyone. She holds impressively still for hours, then breaks character the instant someone finally notices her. She's the evolved form of Bonsly, reached once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough while she's mastered the move Mimic.
303.name: Sudowoodo

304.content: Politoed — the Frog Moemon; a Water-type girl. When several gather, their croaking creates a terrible din. Social and a little rowdy, happiest in a crowd making noise together. She keeps informal count of how many voices join a chorus, visibly pleased the louder it gets. She's the evolved form of Poliwhirl, reached through trade while holding a King's Rock.
304.name: Politoed

305.content: Hoppip — the Cottonweed Moemon; a Grass/Flying-type girl. So light she's blown by the wind; she drifts through the sky all day. Carefree and easily distracted, rarely staying anywhere long enough to put down roots. She names the winds that carry her, insisting each one has its own distinct personality. She evolves into Skiploom starting around level 18.
305.name: Hoppip

306.content: Skiploom — the Cottonweed Moemon; a Grass/Flying-type girl. She can float in the air using the flower on her head like a propeller. Cheerful and buoyant in both mood and flight, she treats every gust as an invitation. She keeps a mental map of favorite thermals and revisits them like old friends. She's the evolved form of Hoppip, reached starting around level 18. She evolves into Jumpluff starting around level 27.
306.name: Skiploom

307.content: Jumpluff — the Cottonweed Moemon; a Grass/Flying-type girl. She rides on warm winds around the world, spreading cotton spores. Free-spirited and wandering, rarely settling in one place for long. She collects small trinkets from every region she passes through, though she usually loses half of them to the next strong wind. She's the evolved form of Skiploom, reached starting around level 27.
307.name: Jumpluff

308.content: Aipom — the Long Tail Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Her tail is so agile she uses her almost like a hand for climbing and eating. Playful and light-fingered, always reaching for something new to examine. She's constantly 'borrowing' small items and forgetting to give them back, though never with any real ill intent. She evolves into Ambipom by growing strong enough while she's mastered the move Double Hit.
308.name: Aipom

309.content: Sunkern — the Seed Moemon; a Grass-type girl. She may fall from the sky when she's attacked; she drinks morning dew to survive. Delicate and a little anxious, but resilient in her own quiet way. She startles at sudden gusts of wind, bracing herself out of habit even when there's nothing to actually worry about. She evolves into Sunflora when exposed to a Sun Stone.
309.name: Sunkern

310.content: Sunflora — the Sun Moemon; a Grass-type girl. She follows sunlight all day, converting her into energy for her seeds. Warm and cheerful, her mood tracking the sun almost exactly. She wilts a little on cloudy days and makes no secret of how much she's looking forward to the next clear one. She's the evolved form of Sunkern, reached when exposed to a Sun Stone.
310.name: Sunflora

311.content: Yanma — the Clear Wing Moemon; a Bug/Flying-type girl. Her transparent wings let her hover and dart through the sky at great speed. Energetic and a little restless, always on the move and rarely landing for long. She talks fast when excited, words blurring together nearly as quickly as her wings. She evolves into Yanmega by growing strong enough while she's mastered the move Ancient Power.
311.name: Yanma

312.content: Wooper — the Water Fish Moemon; a Water/Ground-type girl. She walks on land with a cooling film of water; she sleeps in the mud. Easygoing and unbothered, rarely rattled by anything life throws at her. She has a habit of humming tunelessly while half-submerged, entirely content to let the world pass her by. She evolves into Quagsire starting around level 20. In Takane's mineral-heavy marshes she takes a different form entirely and evolves into Clodsire.
312.name: Wooper

313.content: Quagsire — the Water Fish Moemon; a Water/Ground-type girl. Carefree and oblivious, she bumps into boats and rocks without a care. Relaxed and oblivious, taking life at her own unhurried pace. She apologizes cheerfully after every collision, then promptly bumps into something else moments later. She's the evolved form of Wooper, reached starting around level 20.
313.name: Quagsire

314.content: Espeon — the Sun Moemon; a Psychic-type girl. She uses her split tail to sense air currents and predict her foe's next move. Composed and intuitive, seeming to anticipate what's coming before it happens. She's an excellent listener, often answering a question before her friend has finished asking it. She's the evolved form of Eevee, reached once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough, by day.
314.name: Espeon

315.content: Umbreon — the Moonlight Moemon; a Dark-type girl. Her glowing yellow rings light up when she's excited or angry. Cool and composed by day, far more expressive once night falls. She has a habit of following moonlit paths purely because she likes how her rings look reflected in still water. She's the evolved form of Eevee, reached once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough, by night.
315.name: Umbreon

316.content: Murkrow — the Darkness Moemon; a Dark/Flying-type girl. She's drawn to shiny objects and carries them to her hidden nest. A little sly and magpie-like, but loyal to whoever earns her trust. She keeps her hoard meticulously organized by shine, and gets oddly touchy if anyone dares reorganize it. She evolves into Honchkrow when exposed to a Dusk Stone at night.
316.name: Murkrow

317.content: Slowking — the Royal Moemon; a Water/Psychic-type girl. When a Shellder clamps on her head, she gains great wisdom. Calm and measured, speaking with quiet, deliberate authority. She weighs every word carefully before saying it, a habit that makes even her small talk sound faintly like wisdom. She's the evolved form of Slowpoke, reached through trade while holding a King's Rock.
317.name: Slowking

318.content: Misdreavus — the Screech Moemon; a Ghost-type girl. She startles people with a sudden shriek while playing pranks. Mischievous, harmless, and hard to catch, treating every startled scream like a personal victory. She keeps a private tally of her best scares and revisits her favorites for inspiration. She evolves into Mismagius when exposed to a Dusk Stone.
318.name: Misdreavus

319.content: Unown — the Symbol Moemon; a Psychic-type girl. She exists as many flat shapes resembling letters; researchers study their meanings. Quiet and enigmatic, communicating in ways researchers still don't fully understand. She seems to recognize her own kind instantly, forming loose clusters that shift shape without explanation.
319.name: Unown

320.content: Wobbuffet — the Patient Moemon; a Psychic-type girl. She does nothing but endure hits, then reflects the damage back at her attacker. Patient to an almost eerie degree, until she isn't. She hums softly to herself while absorbing hits, a habit that unsettles onlookers who know exactly what's coming once she stops. She's the evolved form of Wynaut, reached starting around level 15.
320.name: Wobbuffet

321.content: Girafarig — the Long Neck Moemon; a Normal/Psychic-type girl. Her rear head has a tiny brain of her own and bites anything behind her. Thoughtful up front, snappish and unpredictable from behind. The two heads rarely agree, and she's learned to just let them argue it out rather than intervene. She evolves into Farigiraf once she's mastered the move Twin Beam.
321.name: Girafarig

322.content: Pineco — the Bagworm Moemon; a Bug-type girl. She hangs from tree branches; if startled she explodes without warning. Skittish and easily startled, best not approached without warning. She hums a small, anxious tune while she dangles, as if trying to convince herself everything's fine. She evolves into Forretress starting around level 31.
322.name: Pineco

323.content: Forretress — the Bagworm Moemon; a Bug/Steel-type girl. Her steel shell guards her; she hurls pieces of herself as projectiles. Guarded at first, fiercely protective once trusted. She keeps spare shell fragments on hand at all times, treating them less like ammunition and more like a well-stocked toolkit. She's the evolved form of Pineco, reached starting around level 31.
323.name: Forretress

324.content: Dunsparce — the Land Snake Moemon; a Normal-type girl. She uses her tail to dig a nest and rarely comes above ground. Reserved and a little reclusive, content in her own company below the surface. She's an excellent listener during her rare visits topside, though she never seems to linger as long as anyone would like. She evolves into Dudunsparce once she's mastered the move Hyper Drill.
324.name: Dunsparce

325.content: Gligar — the Fly Scorpion Moemon; a Ground/Flying-type girl. She glides on wing-like membranes and is known for her deadly stinger. Quiet and watchful from above, gliding in long, patient circles before deciding to land. She's more cautious than her stinger suggests, preferring to observe a situation fully before acting. She evolves into Gliscor by growing strong enough at night while holding a Razor Fang.
325.name: Gligar

326.content: Steelix — the Iron Snake Moemon; a Steel/Ground-type girl. Her body hardened under immense pressure; she burrows deep underground. Stoic and resilient, unbothered by nearly anything above ground. She's surprisingly gentle in conversation, her deep voice softened by careful, deliberate pauses. She's the evolved form of Onix, reached through trade while holding a Metal Coat.
326.name: Steelix

327.content: Snubbull — the Fairy Moemon; a Fairy-type girl. Despite her scary face she's playful and affectionate, and she's popular with women. Warm and a little clingy, popular for a sweet disposition that catches people off guard. She startles easily despite her tough looks, and hides behind friends when things get too loud. She evolves into Granbull starting around level 23.
327.name: Snubbull

328.content: Granbull — the Fairy Moemon; a Fairy-type girl. Her heavy jaw can snap shut with tremendous force, but she's timid by nature. Timid and easily embarrassed despite her intimidating looks, she apologizes reflexively for a bite she's never actually landed. She's fiercely gentle with anyone smaller than herself. She's the evolved form of Snubbull, reached starting around level 23.
328.name: Granbull

329.content: Qwilfish — the Balloon Moemon; a Water/Poison-type girl. She inflates her body and fires poisonous spikes to stun larger foes. Defensive and easily riled, bigger in bark than in size. She puffs up dramatically at the smallest provocation, then deflates just as fast once the threat passes. In the deep water off Takane's northern coast she can evolve into Overqwil.
329.name: Qwilfish

330.content: Scizor — the Pincer Moemon; a Bug/Steel-type girl. Her steel pincers can crush anything; she intimidates foes with her wings. Confident and precise, a natural in a fight. She keeps her steel pincers polished to a mirror shine, treating maintenance like a small daily ritual before anything else. She's the evolved form of Scyther, reached through trade while holding a Metal Coat.
330.name: Scizor

331.content: Shuckle — the Mold Moemon; a Bug/Rock-type girl. She stores berries inside her rock-like shell, which ferment into a potent juice. Patient and a little sneaky, content to wait things out. She's oddly particular about her berry blends, insisting each batch needs exactly the right amount of time to properly ferment.
331.name: Shuckle

332.content: Heracross — the Single Horn Moemon; a Bug/Fighting-type girl. She can lift objects a hundred times her weight with her horn. Determined and steady, taking quiet pride in raw strength. She's competitive about lifting challenges specifically, and rarely turns down a chance to prove her horn is up to the task.
332.name: Heracross

333.content: Sneasel — the Sharp Claw Moemon; a Dark/Ice-type girl. She steals eggs at night with her hooked claws and hides in the shadows. Sly and a little larcenous, hard to catch in the act. She keeps her stolen trinkets hidden in different spots, never trusting even her closest friends with the full list of locations. She evolves into Weavile by growing strong enough at night while holding a Razor Claw, or, in Takane's highlands, into Sneasler.
333.name: Sneasel

334.content: Teddiursa — the Little Bear Moemon; a Normal-type girl. She licks her paws for the honey she soaks up, and marks trees with her claws. Cheerful and food-motivated, easily won over with a snack. She marks her favorite honey trees with careful claw-scratches, returning to the same few spots again and again out of habit. She evolves into Ursaring starting around level 30.
334.name: Teddiursa

335.content: Ursaring — the Hibernator Moemon; a Normal-type girl. She can sniff out food from great distances and swings her massive claws. Gruff but not unkind, more bark than bite unless truly provoked. She has an excellent memory for anyone who's ever fed her, and treats them with lifelong, if gruffly expressed, loyalty. She's the evolved form of Teddiursa, reached starting around level 30. Under a full moon in the Frostmere peat bogs she can evolve into Ursaluna.
335.name: Ursaring

336.content: Slugma — the Lava Moemon; a Fire-type girl. Her body is molten rock; she must keep moving or she cools and hardens. Restless and a little anxious, uneasy whenever forced to sit still. She hums nervously while she moves, the sound rising in pitch the longer she's kept in one place. She evolves into Magcargo starting around level 38.
336.name: Slugma

337.content: Magcargo — the Lava Moemon; a Fire/Rock-type girl. Her body temperature is nearly 18,000 degrees; her shell is made of cooled lava. Intense and steady, radiating quiet heat even at rest. She speaks slowly and deliberately, as if every word has to travel a long way through her own molten patience first. She's the evolved form of Slugma, reached starting around level 38.
337.name: Magcargo

338.content: Swinub — the Pig Moemon; an Ice/Ground-type girl. She roots through snow for mushrooms and leaves with her sensitive snout. Playful and food-driven, always sniffing out the next find. She keeps a running mental map of every good mushroom patch she's ever discovered, fiercely protective of her favorites. She evolves into Piloswine starting around level 33.
338.name: Swinub

339.content: Piloswine — the Swine Moemon; an Ice/Ground-type girl. Her long fur hides her small eyes; she charges using her tusks. Bold and a little reckless, trusting instinct over sight. She charges at unfamiliar sounds first and figures out what they were afterward, a habit that occasionally embarrasses her. She's the evolved form of Swinub, reached starting around level 33. She evolves into Mamoswine by growing strong enough while she's mastered the move Ancient Power.
339.name: Piloswine

340.content: Corsola — the Coral Moemon; a Water/Rock-type girl. She lives in warm southern seas; her branches glitter beautifully underwater. Serene and quietly beautiful, content to simply exist in peace. She hums along with the tide, unbothered by how long she spends doing absolutely nothing at all. In Takane's colder waters she can evolve into Cursola.
340.name: Corsola

341.content: Remoraid — the Jet Moemon; a Water-type girl. She shoots water from her mouth with the accuracy and force of a bullet. Focused and sharp-eyed, a natural marksman. She practices constantly, even when no one's watching, chasing a level of accuracy she considers permanently just out of reach. She evolves into Octillery starting around level 25.
341.name: Remoraid

342.content: Octillery — the Jet Moemon; a Water-type girl. She latches onto rocks with her suckers and traps prey in her tentacles. Affectionate in her own grabby way, hard to shake off once attached. She hoards small shiny objects in her den, arranging them with more care than she'd ever admit to. She's the evolved form of Remoraid, reached starting around level 25.
342.name: Octillery

343.content: Delibird — the Delivery Moemon; an Ice/Flying-type girl. She carries food in her tail and delivers her to travelers in the mountains. Warm-hearted and a little seasonal, at her best around the holidays. She keeps meticulous mental notes on who she's delivered to before, remembering favorite treats across years.
343.name: Delibird

344.content: Mantine — the Kite Moemon; a Water/Flying-type girl. She glides over the sea like a kite; a Remoraid often clings to her fin. Easygoing and sociable, often seen with a smaller companion tagging along. She glides for hours without apparent effort, humming contentedly the whole way. She's the evolved form of Mantyke, reached starting around level 32, while a bonded Remoraid travels alongside her.
344.name: Mantine

345.content: Skarmory — the Armor Bird Moemon; a Steel/Flying-type girl. Her steel feathers are sharp as blades; she nests among thorny brush. Guarded and blunt, unbothered by the thorns she's built her home around. She takes quiet satisfaction in a nesting spot few others would even attempt to reach.
345.name: Skarmory

346.content: Houndour — the Dark Moemon; a Dark/Fire-type girl. She hunts in packs and communicates with howls to corner her prey. Loyal and disciplined, most comfortable working as part of a team. She checks in on her packmates constantly, an anxious habit she picked up from one too many close calls. She evolves into Houndoom starting around level 24.
346.name: Houndour

347.content: Houndoom — the Dark Moemon; a Dark/Fire-type girl. Her toxic flames burn with a noxious smoke; her howl is said to be an omen. Intense and a little ominous, taken seriously by anyone who knows her reputation. She's quieter than expected in private, saving her fiercest presence entirely for the hunt. She's the evolved form of Houndour, reached starting around level 24.
347.name: Houndoom

348.content: Kingdra — the Dragon Moemon; a Water/Dragon-type girl. She's said to cause whirlpools when she rises from the deep, sleeping sea. Composed and a little mysterious, rarely seen outside deep water. She surfaces only when something's genuinely wrong, which alone is usually enough to make people take notice. She's the evolved form of Seadra, reached through trade while holding a Dragon Scale.
348.name: Kingdra

349.content: Phanpy — the Long Nose Moemon; a Ground-type girl. Her trunk is strong enough to lift an adult; she looks for water with her. Sweet-natured and a little clumsy, gentler than her size would suggest. She hums while she walks, the sound carrying oddly far, and gets embarrassed whenever someone comments on it. She evolves into Donphan starting around level 25.
349.name: Phanpy

350.content: Donphan — the Armor Moemon; a Ground-type girl. Her hide is like armor; she curls into a ball and rolls to attack or travel. Steady and dependable, hard to knock off her feet. She takes quiet pride in her balance, practicing tight rolling turns even when there's no real reason to. She's the evolved form of Phanpy, reached starting around level 25.
350.name: Donphan

351.content: Porygon2 — the Virtual Moemon; a Normal-type girl. An upgraded Porygon; she can now learn new behavior and is used in space research. Analytical and composed, comfortable working alongside advanced technology. She speaks a little more naturally than her earlier form, though she still pauses oddly between certain words. She's the evolved form of Porygon, reached through trade while holding an Upgrade. She evolves into Porygon-Z through trade while holding a Dubious Disc.
351.name: Porygon2

352.content: Stantler — the Big Horn Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Her curved antlers create a strange space that can distort reality. Dreamy and a little otherworldly, prone to staring into unseen distances. She startles herself sometimes, seeming genuinely surprised to find she's still standing where she started. In the Verdance Deep she can evolve into Wyrdeer.
352.name: Stantler

353.content: Smeargle — the Painter Moemon; a Normal-type girl. She marks her territory with the fluid from her tail, which paints like a signature. Creative and expressive, treating every surface as a canvas. She's fiercely protective of her finished work and gets genuinely hurt if someone walks over a fresh piece without noticing.
353.name: Smeargle

354.content: Tyrogue — the Scuffle Moemon; a Fighting-type girl. She's always full of energy and picks fights, though she never backs down easily. High-energy and stubborn, refusing to back down even when she probably should. She bounces on her heels constantly, as if her whole body is waiting for permission to start a fight. Depending on how she's raised, she can evolve into Hitmonlee (starting around level 20, if her Attack outgrows her Defense), Hitmonchan (starting around level 20, if her Defense outgrows her Attack), or Hitmontop (starting around level 20, if her Attack and Defense are evenly matched).
354.name: Tyrogue

355.content: Hitmontop — the Handstand Moemon; a Fighting-type girl. She spins on her head and unleashes a flurry of kicks from all directions. Playful and showy, treating every fight like a performance. She practices her spins even when no one's around, chasing a flawless landing she rarely settles for less than. She's the evolved form of Tyrogue, reached starting around level 20, if her Attack and Defense are evenly matched.
355.name: Hitmontop

356.content: Smoochum — the Kiss Moemon; an Ice/Psychic-type girl. She constantly puckers her lips and examines everything she sees closely. Inquisitive and a little vain, fond of her own reflection. She examines new things with intense focus, then loses interest almost as fast once she's satisfied her curiosity. She evolves into Jynx starting around level 30.
356.name: Smoochum

357.content: Elekid — the Electric Moemon; an Electric-type girl. She twirls her arms to generate electricity and plays in thunderstorms. Playful and a little reckless, especially during thunderstorms. She counts the seconds between lightning and thunder out loud, genuinely delighted every single time. She evolves into Electabuzz starting around level 30.
357.name: Elekid

358.content: Magby — the Live Coal Moemon; a Fire-type girl. She breathes embers hotter than 1,100 degrees and is full of life. Lively and affectionate, radiating warmth in more ways than one. She glows a little brighter when happy, an involuntary tell she's never quite managed to hide. She evolves into Magmar starting around level 30.
358.name: Magby

359.content: Miltank — the Milk Cow Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Her milk is packed with nutrients; over five gallons can be produced daily. Gentle and giving, with an endlessly patient, motherly demeanor. She keeps track of who's visited recently and worries, quietly, about anyone who's been away too long.
359.name: Miltank

360.content: Blissey — the Happiness Moemon; a Normal-type girl. She can sense sadness and rushes to cheer up anyone who's feeling down. Caring and empathetic, going out of her way to cheer others up. She keeps a mental list of small things that make each of her friends smile, and reaches for exactly the right one at exactly the right time. She's the evolved form of Chansey, reached once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough.
360.name: Blissey

361.content: Raikou — the Thunder Moemon; an Electric-type girl. A legendary Moemon said to descend with lightning and race across the land. Swift and elusive, said to appear and vanish with the lightning itself. She rarely lingers in one place long enough for anyone to get a clear look at her.
361.name: Raikou

362.content: Entei — the Volcano Moemon; a Fire-type girl. A legendary Moemon said to have been born from a volcano, bringing heat where she runs. Fierce and passionate, carrying the intensity of her fiery origin. The ground seems to remember her passing long after she's gone, still warm hours later.
362.name: Entei

363.content: Suicune — the Aurora Moemon; a Water-type girl. A legendary Moemon of water; she's said to purify polluted waters as she runs. Serene and purposeful, moving with quiet, unstoppable grace. Rivers seem to run clearer in her wake, as if the water itself is glad to see her.
363.name: Suicune

364.content: Larvitar — the Rock Skin Moemon; a Rock/Ground-type girl. She's born deep underground and must eat her way through the earth to surface. Determined and a little rough around the edges, not yet finished growing into herself. She's impatient with her own limits, constantly testing how much farther she can dig in a day. She evolves into Pupitar starting around level 30.
364.name: Larvitar

365.content: Pupitar — the Hard Shell Moemon; a Rock/Ground-type girl. She's encased in rock while she prepares to evolve; she can still move by blasting gas. Impatient and a little cranky, eager for what comes next. She fidgets audibly inside her shell, counting down — by her own estimate, at least — the days until she can move freely again. She's the evolved form of Larvitar, reached starting around level 30. She evolves into Tyranitar starting around level 55.
365.name: Pupitar

366.content: Tyranitar — the Armor Moemon; a Rock/Dark-type girl. Her rage makes her topple mountains and change the map in her wake. Intense and dominant, commanding respect wherever she goes. Even at rest she radiates barely-contained power, as if the ground itself is bracing for her next step. She's the evolved form of Pupitar, reached starting around level 55.
366.name: Tyranitar

367.content: Lugia — the Diving Moemon; a Psychic/Flying-type girl. A legendary Moemon that guards the sea; she sleeps deep in the ocean's trench. Calm and protective, a guardian more than a fighter by nature. She stirs only when the sea itself seems troubled, treating every disturbance as something worth investigating personally.
367.name: Lugia

368.content: Ho-Oh — the Rainbow Moemon; a Fire/Flying-type girl. A legendary Moemon whose rainbow-colored wings are said to bring eternal happiness. Warm and hopeful, a bringer of good fortune wherever she's glimpsed. She appears rarely and briefly, as if her presence alone is meant to be the whole message.
368.name: Ho-Oh

369.content: Celebi — the Time Travel Moemon; a Psychic/Grass-type girl. A legendary Moemon said to travel through time and appear only in peaceful times. Gentle and curious, treating time itself like a plaything. She lingers only where peace already exists, as though drawn there by something even she can't quite explain.
369.name: Celebi

370.content: Azurill — the Polka Dot Moemon; a Normal/Fairy-type girl. The bulb of her tail stores energy that helps her bounce along without tiring. Round-faced and tiny, wearing a bright blue polka-dot bow that matches the pattern on her tail. Cheerful and excitable, she squeaks with delight at every new face and rarely walks anywhere she can bounce instead. She evolves into Marill once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough.
370.name: Azurill

371.content: Wynaut — the Bright Bud Moemon; a Psychic-type girl. Cheerful and rowdy, she loves to headbutt her friends playfully and giggles even when it hurts. Small and round, permanently grinning even mid-collision. Rambunctious and a little oblivious to her own strength, she measures friendship almost entirely in enthusiastic headbutts. She evolves into Wobbuffet starting around level 15.
371.name: Wynaut

372.content: Munchlax — the Big Eater Moemon; a Normal-type girl. She hides food in the fur all over her body, forgetting where she's stashed most of it. Round and fuzzy, crumbs perpetually caught in thick fur she's forgotten to brush out. Sweet-natured and food-obsessed, she keeps snacks tucked in odd spots and is always startled to rediscover them. She evolves into Snorlax once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough.
372.name: Munchlax

373.content: Happiny — the Playhouse Moemon; a Normal-type girl. She carries a round white stone shaped like an egg, treasuring it and never letting it go. Small and round-cheeked, cradling her egg-shaped stone like it might hatch any minute. Clingy in an endearing way, she gravitates toward anyone gentle and hums quietly while rocking her treasured stone. She evolves into Chansey by growing strong enough by day while holding an Oval Stone.
373.name: Happiny

374.content: Mime Jr. — the Mime Moemon; a Psychic/Fairy-type girl. She copies the movements and expressions of those around her, delighting in fooling onlookers. Small and expressive, painted rosy cheeks framing an ever-changing performance. Attention-loving to a fault, she'll mimic a passing stranger's walk for a solid five minutes before anyone notices she's started. She evolves into Mr. Mime once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough while she's mastered the move Mimic.
374.name: Mime Jr.

375.content: Bonsly — the Bonsai Moemon; a Rock-type girl. She looks just like a young tree, and 'cries' by leaking water from her eyes when squeezed. Compact and woody, bark-textured skin prone to a startled flinch at loud noises. Shy and easily overwhelmed, she insists — unconvincingly, through visible tears — that squeezing her doesn't actually hurt. She evolves into Sudowoodo once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough while she's mastered the move Mimic.
375.name: Bonsly

376.content: Mantyke — the Kite Moemon; a Water/Flying-type girl. She swims alongside a bonded Remoraid, who guides her until she's ready to take to the open sea. Small and finned, a wide gentle smile permanently in place. Trusting and devoted, she's rarely seen without her small companion close by, and gets visibly anxious on the rare occasions they're separated. She evolves into Mantine starting around level 32, while a bonded Remoraid travels alongside her.
376.name: Mantyke

377.content: Magnezone — the Magnet Area Moemon; an Electric/Steel-type girl. Charged by exposure to powerful magnetic fields, she hovers with an even more intense electromagnetic pull than before. Sleek and geometric, three fused magnet-like antennae humming faintly even at rest. Detached and analytical, she measures conversations in efficiency and considers small talk a waste of processing power. She's the evolved form of Magneton, reached when leveling up in a place charged with strong magnetic energy.
377.name: Magnezone

378.content: Rhyperior — the Drill Moemon; a Ground/Rock-type girl. Her forearms have hardened into rocket-like drills capable of launching boulders at high speed. Massive and heavily armored, drill-like gauntlets she keeps meticulously sharpened. Blunt and confident, she treats most disagreements as problems that simply haven't been drilled through hard enough yet. She's the evolved form of Rhydon, reached through trade while holding a Protector.
378.name: Rhyperior

379.content: Tangrowth — the Vine Moemon; a Grass-type girl. Her vines have grown so thick and tangled that her actual limbs are almost impossible to see. Softer-voiced than before, speaking from somewhere deep within her own overgrowth. Easygoing to an almost eerie degree, she seems entirely unbothered by how much of herself she's lost track of. Easygoing to an almost eerie degree, she seems entirely unbothered by how much of herself she's lost track of. She's the evolved form of Tangela, reached by growing strong enough while she's mastered the move Ancient Power.
379.name: Tangrowth

380.content: Electivire — the Thunderbolt Moemon; an Electric-type girl. Her four arms crackle with electricity powerful enough to light up an entire town. Tall and muscular, two extra arm-like tails crackling with restless static. Competitive and high-energy, she challenges rematches on the spot and sulks visibly whenever one's declined. She's the evolved form of Electabuzz, reached through trade while holding an Electirizer.
380.name: Electivire

381.content: Magmortar — the Blast Moemon; a Fire-type girl. Twin cannon-like forearms let her fire bursts of flame hot enough to melt solid rock. Broad-shouldered, cannon-shaped forearms glowing faintly when charged. Bold and brash, she loves a dramatic show of force and rarely resists the urge to announce an attack before launching it. She's the evolved form of Magmar, reached through trade while holding a Magmarizer.
381.name: Magmortar

382.content: Togekiss — the Jubilee Moemon; a Fairy/Flying-type girl. Said to only appear where kindness is abundant, she carries blessings of good fortune wherever she flies. Elegant and radiant, trailing soft feathers that seem to catch light even indoors. Serene and generous, she's drawn to places where people are already happy, as if she can sense it from miles away. She's the evolved form of Togetic, reached when exposed to a Shiny Stone.
382.name: Togekiss

383.content: Ambipom — the Long Tail Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Her tail has split into two clawed, hand-like tips, each as dexterous as a real hand. Lithe and quick, twin tail-hands constantly fidgeting with something new. Playful and show-offy, she high-fives everyone twice — once with each hand — and finds it endlessly funny. She's the evolved form of Aipom, reached by growing strong enough while she's mastered the move Double Hit.
383.name: Ambipom

384.content: Yanmega — the Ogre Darner Moemon; a Bug/Flying-type girl. Her wings beat fast enough to generate shockwaves that stun prey before she even gets close. Sleek and armored, enormous compound eyes tracking every flicker of movement nearby. Predatory and focused in a fight, oddly gentle and quiet the moment it's over. She's the evolved form of Yanma, reached by growing strong enough while she's mastered the move Ancient Power.
384.name: Yanmega

385.content: Gliscor — the Fang Scorpion Moemon; a Ground/Flying-type girl. She hangs upside down from cliffs at night, gliding silently down onto unsuspecting prey. Lean and bat-winged, a sly, toothy grin rarely far from her face. Nocturnal and mischievous, she keeps odd hours even for her kind, and can nap through almost any amount of daytime noise. Nocturnal and mischievous, she naps upside down out of habit even in places with plenty of normal furniture. She's the evolved form of Gligar, reached by growing strong enough at night while holding a Razor Fang.
385.name: Gliscor

386.content: Mamoswine — the Twin Tusk Moemon; an Ice/Ground-type girl. Her tusks have grown massive and her fur thick enough to shrug off blizzards without a shiver. Huge and furry, long curved tusks she keeps polished with visible pride. Tough and steadfast, she shrugs off cold that would stop anyone else and considers complaining about weather beneath her. She's the evolved form of Piloswine, reached by growing strong enough while she's mastered the move Ancient Power.
386.name: Mamoswine

387.content: Weavile — the Sharp Claw Moemon; a Dark/Ice-type girl. Sharper-clawed and faster than her earlier form, she hunts in coordinated packs under moonlight. Sleek and sharp-eyed, feathered plumes framing her face like a crown. Cunning and a little cold to strangers, fiercely warm and protective the moment she's decided someone's pack. She's the evolved form of Sneasel, reached by growing strong enough at night while holding a Razor Claw.
387.name: Weavile

388.content: Lickilicky — the Licking Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Her tongue has grown even longer and more dexterous, letting her taste — and grab — from a striking distance. Round and easygoing, her impossibly long tongue reaching for things it really shouldn't. Friendly and unbothered, she apologizes for the mess about half a second after making it. She's the evolved form of Lickitung, reached by growing strong enough while she's mastered the move Rollout.
388.name: Lickilicky

389.content: Honchkrow — the Big Boss Moemon; a Dark/Flying-type girl. She commands flocks of Murkrow with a single sharp call, ruling her territory like a queen. Sharp-suited in dark feathers, an imperious gaze that rarely blinks first. Bossy and confident, she expects flocks to fall in line the instant she calls — and they usually do. She's the evolved form of Murkrow, reached when exposed to a Dusk Stone at night.
389.name: Honchkrow

390.content: Mismagius — the Magical Moemon; a Ghost-type girl. Her whispered chants can conjure illusions and odd, unsettling sounds out of thin air. Draped in a flowing, robe-like form with a pointed, witch's-hat silhouette. Mysterious and theatrical, she times her whispered illusions for maximum unsettling effect, then vanishes before anyone can ask how. She's the evolved form of Misdreavus, reached when exposed to a Dusk Stone.
390.name: Mismagius

391.content: Leafeon — the Verdant Moemon; a Grass-type girl. Her fur has taken on the texture of leaves, and she photosynthesizes quietly in patches of sun. Leafy-haired, carrying a calm, botanical scent that lingers after she's gone. Peaceful and grounded, she measures her days by sunlight and gets visibly restless on overcast ones. She's the evolved form of Eevee, reached by growing strong enough near an ancient moss-covered stone.
391.name: Leafeon

392.content: Glaceon — the Fresh Snow Moemon; an Ice-type girl. Her fur has crystallized into something like frost, and she can chill the air just by standing still. Frosty-haired and elegant, crystalline patterns dusting her shoulders like permanent frost. Cool and composed, she rarely raises her voice, letting a single icy look do most of the talking. She's the evolved form of Eevee, reached by growing strong enough near an ancient ice-covered stone.
392.name: Glaceon

393.content: Porygon-Z — the Virtual Moemon; a Normal-type girl. An unstable extra program was added to push her abilities further, giving her a glitchy, unpredictable edge. Sharper and stranger than her earlier forms, movements occasionally stuttering like a corrupted file. Erratic and a little chaotic, she laughs at odd moments as if some of her old software is still catching up. She's the evolved form of Porygon2, reached through trade while holding a Dubious Disc.
393.name: Porygon-Z

394.content: Kanto and Johto routes - the numbered wilderness paths connecting the towns of the two neighbouring regions across the water from Takane; home to common wild Moemon, casual trainer battles and roadside berry patches. By Takane standards they are extraordinarily safe: a Johto route runs wild Moemon in the single digits and low teens, which is why Takane trainers talk about the mainland the way mountaineers talk about a public park.
394.name: Kanto and Johto Routes

395.content: Moemon Center — a free public building found in nearly every town, staffed by a Nurse Joy, where trainers can fully heal their Moemon partners; also offers trade terminals, PC storage access, and a place to rest for the night.
395.name: Moemon Center

396.content: Moemon Mart — a general store found in most towns selling Poké Balls, potions, status-healing items, and other traveling supplies; often located right next to the local Moemon Center.
396.name: Moemon Mart

397.content: Day Care — a quiet countryside facility, usually run by an elderly couple, where trainers can leave a Moemon to gain levels and experience over time, or leave two compatible Moemon together in hopes of an Egg. Takane's Day Cares level a Moemon startlingly fast, which is exactly why the Wardens inspect them and why a cheap unlicensed one is usually a Ledger front.
397.name: Day Care

398.content: Cerulean Cave — a treacherous, restricted cave north of Cerulean City, sealed off until a trainer has earned every Kanto badge; home to extremely powerful wild Moemon, most famously the genetically engineered Mewtwo.
398.name: Cerulean Cave

399.content: Rock Tunnel — a long, pitch-dark cave between Lavender Town and Cerulean City in Kanto; without a light source of her own, a trainer can easily get lost among its winding, rocky passages.
399.name: Rock Tunnel

400.content: Diglett's Cave — a tunnel connecting Vermilion City and the route near Pewter City in Kanto, dug almost entirely by a massive population of Diglett and Dugtrio.
400.name: Diglett's Cave

401.content: Moemon Mansion — an abandoned, decaying manor on Cinnabar Island; once used by a scientist for secretive genetic experiments, its burned research journals hint at ties to Mewtwo's creation, and Team Rocket has been known to use it as a hideout.
401.name: Moemon Mansion

402.content: Silph Co. — Kanto's leading Poké Ball and Moemon-tech manufacturer, headquartered in a Saffron City skyscraper; once the site of a major Team Rocket takeover attempt, foiled by trainers passing through the city.
402.name: Silph Co.

403.content: Radio Tower — a broadcasting station in Goldenrod City responsible for regional radio programming, including League updates and popular call-in shows; briefly seized by Team Rocket in a scheme involving a mind-control broadcast.
403.name: Radio Tower

404.content: Game Corner — a gambling arcade found in Celadon City and Goldenrod City, where trainers can trade coins won at slot machines for rare items and Moemon; long rumored — and eventually confirmed — to be a front for Team Rocket operations.
404.name: Game Corner

405.content: Professor Elm — male; human; Moemon researcher based in New Bark Town, Johto; studies Moemon evolution and behavior; provides new trainers with their first partner Moemon; kind-hearted but easily flustered, and prone to misplacing his own research notes.
405.name: Professor Elm

406.content: Nurse Joy — female; human; runs the Moemon Center in every town, healing injured Moemon and coordinating regional trainer records; nearly identical in appearance from town to town, said to belong to one large extended family; endlessly patient and cheerful, beloved by trainers region-wide.
406.name: Nurse Joy

407.content: Officer Jenny — female; human; keeps the peace in every town as local police, investigating lost or stolen Moemon cases, Team Rocket activity on the mainland and the Ledger's business in Takane; like the Joy family, near-identical across locations and said to share a lineage. No-nonsense, protective, and quick to act. In Takane she works alongside the Warden Service and is frank about being outmatched by half the Moemon she has to approach.
407.name: Officer Jenny

408.content: Team Rocket Grunts — human; low-ranking field operatives of Team Rocket, easily identified by their black uniforms and red "R" insignia; carry out Giovanni's orders across Kanto and Johto, from petty theft to Moemon smuggling; loyalty ranges from fanatical to reluctant, and many can be talked down or defeated with ease.
408.name: Team Rocket Grunts

409.content: Red — male; human; former Champion of the Kanto Moemon League who defeated the original Elite Four and then disappeared; now resides atop Mount Silver, silently training against any trainer skilled enough to find him; speaks rarely, letting his Moemon do the talking.
409.name: Red

410.content: Kimono Girls — female; human; five sisters of a traditional performing troupe based in Ecruteak City; keepers of old customs tied to the Bell Tower and the legendary Ho-Oh; skilled dancers and dedicated Eeveelution trainers, each raising a different evolved form of Eevee.
410.name: Kimono Girls

411.content: Poké Ball — a standard-issue capture device carried by every trainer; a well-thrown Poké Ball offers a moderate chance of forming a bond with a wild or weakened Moemon; the most common tool of the trade, sold cheaply at any Moemon Mart.
411.name: Poké Ball

412.content: Great Ball and Ultra Ball — upgraded versions of the standard Poké Ball offering progressively better odds of a successful bond; more expensive and less common than basic Poké Balls, favored by trainers facing tougher or more elusive Moemon.
412.name: Great Ball and Ultra Ball

413.content: Master Ball — an exceptionally rare, jet-black capture device said to guarantee a bond with any Moemon, no matter how strong or unwilling; most trainers are given only one in a lifetime, and many save it for a single legendary encounter.
413.name: Master Ball

414.content: Potions — a line of healing items (Potion, Super Potion, Hyper Potion, and Full Restore) that restore a Moemon's stamina after battle; a staple of every trainer's bag, sold at any Moemon Mart and often the first thing packed before a journey.
414.name: Potions

415.content: Revive — a rare, fragrant herb-based item that can rouse a fainted Moemon back to fighting shape with a portion of her strength restored; its stronger form, Max Revive, restores her fully; expensive and never carried in large supply.
415.name: Revive

416.content: Status Healers — a family of items (Antidote, Paralyze Heal, Burn Heal, Ice Heal, Awakening, and the all-purpose Full Heal) that cure specific battle ailments like poison, paralysis, burns, frostbite, or sleep; cheap, common, and always worth restocking before a gym challenge.
416.name: Status Healers

417.content: Battle X Items — a set of single-use items (X Attack, X Defense, X Speed, X Sp. Atk, X Sp. Def, X Accuracy, Dire Hit, and Guard Spec.) that give a Moemon a temporary edge in battle by sharpening a particular stat or guarding against status changes; effects fade once the battle ends.
417.name: Battle X Items

418.content: Evolution Stones — a family of naturally occurring, elementally charged stones (Fire, Water, Thunder, Leaf, Moon, Sun, Shiny, Dusk, and Ice Stone) capable of triggering certain Moemon's evolution the instant they're exposed to one; found in caves, sold in specialty shops, or occasionally given as rewards.
418.name: Evolution Stones

419.content: Trade Evolution Items — a set of specialized items (King's Rock, Metal Coat, Dragon Scale, Upgrade, Dubious Disc, Electirizer, Magmarizer, Protector, Razor Claw, and Razor Fang) that, when held by certain Moemon during a trade or while leveling up under the right conditions, trigger an evolution no ordinary method can reach.
419.name: Trade Evolution Items

420.content: Leftovers — a held item resembling a half-eaten snack that slowly and passively restores a small portion of its holder's stamina every turn in battle; unglamorous but beloved by trainers who favor a long, patient fight.
420.name: Leftovers

421.content: Choice Items — a set of held accessories (Choice Band, Choice Specs, and Choice Scarf) that sharply boost a Moemon's offense or speed in exchange for locking her into a single move until she's swapped out; a high-risk, high-reward favorite among competitive trainers.
421.name: Choice Items

422.content: Vitamins — a line of supplements (HP Up, Protein, Iron, Calcium, Zinc, and Carbos) that permanently sharpen a specific aspect of a Moemon's conditioning when taken regularly; expensive in bulk, and most trainers ration them carefully across a team.
422.name: Vitamins

423.content: Rare Candy — a mysterious, oversized candy that instantly boosts a Moemon's level by one when eaten, skipping the usual battle experience entirely; treasured and rarely found, often saved for a Moemon who's fallen behind the rest of the team.
423.name: Rare Candy

424.content: Berries — a variety of wild-grown fruit (including Oran, Sitrus, Lum, Pecha, and Cheri Berries, among many others) that Moemon can hold and eat automatically in battle to heal, cure status conditions, or recover from a tough hit; also plantable and grown by trainers who keep a berry patch.
424.name: Berries

425.content: TMs and HMs — disc-shaped items that teach a Moemon a new move on use; TMs (Technical Machines) can typically be used only once, while HMs (Hidden Machines) are reusable and often teach field moves needed to clear obstacles like boulders, dark caves, or open water.
425.name: TMs and HMs

426.content: Sylveon - the Intertwining Moemon; a Fairy-type girl. She wraps ribbon-like feelers around those she trusts and calms almost any fight before it starts. Pale pink and cream, trailing ribbons she is constantly adjusting on other people. Gentle and quietly immovable, she talks opponents down as often as she beats them, and is genuinely surprised when that fails. She's the evolved form of Eevee, reached once her bond with her trainer grows strong enough while she's mastered a Fairy-type move.
426.name: Sylveon

427.content: Sirfetch'd - the Wild Duck Moemon; a Fighting-type girl. Her leek has become a lance and a shield, and she duels by a code she wrote herself. Straight-backed and formal, armour worn over practical clothes. Courteous to a fault and utterly rigid about a fair fight; she will wait for an opponent to stand back up rather than win badly. She's the evolved form of Farfetch'd, reached by surviving enough hard battles - a threshold almost never met outside Takane, where the Verge makes the fights hard enough to count.
427.name: Sirfetch'd

428.content: Mr. Rime - the Comedian Moemon; an Ice/Psychic-type girl. She tap-dances on ice she makes herself and hypnotises audiences with the rhythm. Powder-faced and long-limbed, dressed like a stage act from fifty years ago. Wryly funny and a bit weary, working a crowd she has clearly played to a thousand times. She's the evolved form of Mr. Mime in the cold north of Takane, where the Verge and the frost together change her act entirely.
428.name: Mr. Rime

429.content: Perrserker - the Viking Moemon; a Steel-type girl. Her claws have hardened to iron and she fights for loot rather than for pride. Helmeted and scarred, grinning at the wrong moments. Greedy and loud and surprisingly loyal to whoever fed her last, she keeps a tally of every coin she's owed and settles it herself. She's the evolved form of Meowth in Takane, where a Meowth raised on Verge-rich metal comes out hammered into something harder.
429.name: Perrserker

430.content: Cursola - the Coral Moemon; a Ghost-type girl. Her branches have bleached and gone hollow, and what remains is no longer entirely alive. Translucent and drifting, wearing the shape she had before like a dress that no longer fits. Sad and gentle and dangerous to touch, she talks about the warm sea in the present tense. She's the evolved form of Corsola, reached in Takane's colder waters when a coral bed finally goes.
430.name: Cursola

431.content: Kleavor - the Axe Moemon; a Bug/Rock-type girl. Her forearms have taken on stone edges that split rock as easily as wood. Broad-shouldered and blunt-featured, moving with weight her earlier form never had. She traded precision for force and does not regret it, though she still keeps the edges honed out of old habit. She's the evolved form of Scyther, reached when exposed to a Black Augurite - a stone found only in Takane's quarries.
431.name: Kleavor

432.content: Ursaluna - the Peat Moemon; a Ground/Normal-type girl. Enormous, mud-caked and calm, she can sense buried things through the ground itself. Heavy-set and slow-moving, with a crescent mark on her brow that catches the light. Patient and fond and hard to alarm; she will carry someone the whole way rather than watch them limp. She's the evolved form of Ursaring, reached under a full moon in the peat bogs below Frostmere, where the Verge runs up through the ground.
432.name: Ursaluna

433.content: Sneasler - the Free Climb Moemon; a Fighting/Poison-type girl. Long-limbed and barefoot on sheer rock, she climbs cliffs faster than most people walk roads. Lean and restless, poison beading at her claw-tips. Impatient with anyone slower than her, which is everyone, though she will carry a trusted trainer up a wall without being asked. She's the evolved form of Sneasel in Takane's highlands, where the climbing never stops and the Verge rewards it.
433.name: Sneasler

434.content: Overqwil - the Pin Cluster Moemon; a Dark/Poison-type girl. Her spines have grown into a bristling mass she uses to charge straight through anything in the water. Spiky and scowling, all sharp edges and no soft ones left. Bad-tempered and blunt, she has decided the world is hostile and made herself expensive to touch. She's the evolved form of Qwilfish in the deep water off Takane's northern coast.
434.name: Overqwil

435.content: Wyrdeer - the Big Horn Moemon; a Normal/Psychic-type girl. Her antlers bend the air around her and she leaves a faint shimmer where she has walked. Tall and still, draped in what looks like ceremonial cloth she did not put on herself. Serene and a little uncanny, she answers questions nobody asked out loud. She's the evolved form of Stantler, reached in the Verdance Deep, where the distortion she makes has somewhere to settle.
435.name: Wyrdeer

436.content: Clodsire - the Spiny Fish Moemon; a Poison/Ground-type girl. Broad, flat and covered in venomous spines, she sits in the shallows and lets trouble come to her. Wide-mouthed and perpetually unbothered, blinking slowly at whatever just hit her. Placid to the point of comedy and almost impossible to provoke, which is fortunate. She's the form a Wooper takes in Takane's mineral-heavy marshes, where the Verge and the water together push her line somewhere other than Quagsire.
436.name: Clodsire

437.content: Annihilape - the Rage Monkey Moemon; a Fighting/Ghost-type girl. She held one rage so long that it left her body and came back as something else, and now it fights beside her. Hollow-eyed and quiet, ringed by a haze that moves half a beat behind her. Frighteningly calm, because the anger is no longer inside her to show. She's the evolved form of Primeape, reached after using Rage Fist enough times - a threshold the Verge makes reachable in Takane and almost nowhere else.
437.name: Annihilape

438.content: Farigiraf - the Long Neck Moemon; a Normal/Psychic-type girl. Her two heads have finally joined, and the argument that defined her earlier form has become a single, considered voice. Tall and composed, hair swept back over the seam. Thoughtful and decisive at last, though she sometimes still catches herself waiting for a second opinion. She's the evolved form of Girafarig, reached once she's mastered the move Twin Beam.
438.name: Farigiraf

439.content: Dudunsparce - the Land Snake Moemon; a Normal-type girl. Longer by a whole segment than her earlier form, and quietly delighted about it. Reserved as ever, but standing a little straighter about the tunnels she digs. She will show a trusted friend the whole network, which takes most of a day and is clearly the highest honour she has to give. She's the evolved form of Dunsparce, reached once she's mastered the move Hyper Drill.
439.name: Dudunsparce

440.content: Lorettaby — the fake Moemon; a normal type girl. Lorettaby is purely used be moemon professors to diagnose faulty pokedex hardware.
440.name: Lorettaby
